reference: glibc locale(1) output for the locales bash-os ships (C, C.utf8, POSIX), recorded from Debian glibc 2.41 `env -i locale ...`. The reference host lists its own installed locales, so these are contracts with the recorded bytes, not live parity.
coverage: glibc-shaped locale listing, -a, -m, keyword/-k/-c queries and unknown-name diagnostics for the shipped locales; the bash-os verbs.
exclusions: Locales other than C, C.utf8 and POSIX: bash-os ships no locale data.
Keywords outside LC_CTYPE charmap and LC_NUMERIC.

cases.purpose: With no locale variables, `locale` prints LANG=, LANGUAGE=, each category as "POSIX" and LC_ALL= (glibc layout).
cases.script:
unset LC_ALL LANG LANGUAGE LC_CTYPE LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME LC_COLLATE LC_MONETARY LC_MESSAGES LC_PAPER LC_NAME LC_ADDRESS LC_TELEPHONE LC_MEASUREMENT LC_IDENTIFICATION
locale
cases.stdout:
LANG=
LANGUAGE=
LC_CTYPE="POSIX"
LC_NUMERIC="POSIX"
LC_TIME="POSIX"
LC_COLLATE="POSIX"
LC_MONETARY="POSIX"
LC_MESSAGES="POSIX"
LC_PAPER="POSIX"
LC_NAME="POSIX"
LC_ADDRESS="POSIX"
LC_TELEPHONE="POSIX"
LC_MEASUREMENT="POSIX"
LC_IDENTIFICATION="POSIX"
LC_ALL=

cases.purpose: LANG sets every category; an explicitly set category prints unquoted.
cases.script:
unset LC_ALL LANG LANGUAGE LC_CTYPE LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME LC_COLLATE LC_MONETARY LC_MESSAGES LC_PAPER LC_NAME LC_ADDRESS LC_TELEPHONE LC_MEASUREMENT LC_IDENTIFICATION
export LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_TIME=POSIX
locale | sed -n '1p;3p;5p'

cases.purpose: -a lists the available locales and -m the charmaps (guest compatibility pass 1).
cases.script:
unset LC_ALL LANG LANGUAGE LC_CTYPE LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME LC_COLLATE LC_MONETARY LC_MESSAGES LC_PAPER LC_NAME LC_ADDRESS LC_TELEPHONE LC_MEASUREMENT LC_IDENTIFICATION
locale -a
locale -m

cases.purpose: Keyword queries: charmap follows LC_ALL/LC_CTYPE/LANG; -k prints name=value; a category name prints its keywords.
cases.script:
unset LC_ALL LANG LANGUAGE LC_CTYPE LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME LC_COLLATE LC_MONETARY LC_MESSAGES LC_PAPER LC_NAME LC_ADDRESS LC_TELEPHONE LC_MEASUREMENT LC_IDENTIFICATION
locale charmap
LANG=C.UTF-8 locale charmap
LC_ALL=C locale decimal_point thousands_sep grouping
locale -k decimal_point charmap
locale -ck grouping
locale LC_NUMERIC
cases.stdout:
ANSI_X3.4-1968
UTF-8
.

-1
decimal_point="."
charmap="ANSI_X3.4-1968"
LC_NUMERIC
grouping=-1
.

-1

cases.purpose: An unknown keyword prints glibc's diagnostic and exits 1; known keywords still print.
cases.script:
unset LC_ALL LANG LANGUAGE LC_CTYPE LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME LC_COLLATE LC_MONETARY LC_MESSAGES LC_PAPER LC_NAME LC_ADDRESS LC_TELEPHONE LC_MEASUREMENT LC_IDENTIFICATION
locale bogusname charmap 2>err || echo rc=$?
sed 's/^[^:]*: //' err

cases.purpose: The bash-os set/current/validate verbs are unchanged.
cases.script:
unset LC_ALL LANG LANGUAGE LC_CTYPE LC_NUMERIC LC_TIME LC_COLLATE LC_MONETARY LC_MESSAGES LC_PAPER LC_NAME LC_ADDRESS LC_TELEPHONE LC_MEASUREMENT LC_IDENTIFICATION
locale validate C.UTF-8 && echo valid
locale set CTYPE C.utf8
locale current CTYPE
